inlines.v: BEAU'TIFY, verb transitive bu'tify. [beauty and Latin facio.] To make or render beautiful; to adorn; to deck; to grace; to add beauty to; to embellish. BEAU'TIFY, verb intransitive bu'tify. To become beautiful; to advance in beauty.
